note: SYC's LANK and FK r's DELKOD are documented nowhere in their registers, so each entry mints its own variable on the named variant, held once over its holdings_period; LANK's authored data_warning annotates its holding. KOD is documented on SYC_A from 2015, so its entry is refused as stale even though its 2005-2014 holding does not overlap those years: the minted name would be the documented variable's own source id, and a documented column is carried instead.
fails_if: `_compile_provider_columns` matches the variant by another spelling than the register's errata label (DELKOD or LANK is stale), drops the pooled holdings period or the authored data_warning, or admits a mint of a column the register documents (KOD gains a second variable)
